title: ohho.artifacts/v1
description: Sidecar for one training run. Records pin, promote, and prune state plus checkpoint deletions. ohho run retain writes it. Retention does not rewrite run_manifest.json or metrics.json.

experiment.description: Experiment id for this run. Null until set. A parent directory name is not written here.

pinned.description: Pinned runs are never deleted by retention.

promoted.description: Promoted runs are never deleted by retention.

pruned.description: Pruned trials are eligible to lose intermediate checkpoints after the retention window.

pruned_at.description: UTC time the trial was marked pruned. Null when the trial is not pruned. The retention clock is the checkpoint mtime, not this field.

checkpoints.description: Checkpoints still on disk under checkpoints/.

path.description: Path relative to the run directory, POSIX separators.

deletions.description: Checkpoints retention removed. The files are gone; the manifest and metrics are not.
